description.en:
Waits until the player presses A or B, or touches the touch screen, then returns true. It checks once per frame, after a suspend(), so it always takes at least one frame.
It never returns false, so a caller's while (!BtnImageNext()) loop body never runs: the wait happens inside BtnImageNext itself. ShowTutorialEx uses it to wait before closing a tutorial image.
Always true, once A, B or a touch has been detected.

examples.case: Waiting before closing a tutorial page (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, ShowTutorialEx)
